ANALYSIS_ARCHITECTURE_SCHEMA.name: analysis_architecture
ANALYSIS_ARCHITECTURE_SCHEMA.description: Map a project: workspace structure, dependency graph, hot paths, import cycles, complexity hotspots. Returns apps/packages, top dependencies, cycle list and the most-imported files. Use it before a refactor or to explain a codebase. Next: analysis_inspect on the top-ranked files.

response_format.description: concise returns core fields only (~1/3 of the tokens); detailed returns everything.

ANALYSIS_ASK_SCHEMA.name: analysis_ask
ANALYSIS_ASK_SCHEMA.description: Ask a natural-language question about the codebase and answer it from stored analysis context. Returns the answer plus the evidence it used. Use it when you do not know which tool would answer the question. Next: run the concrete tool the answer points at.

question.description: A natural language question about the code.

ANALYSIS_DEADCODE_SCHEMA.name: analysis_deadcode
ANALYSIS_DEADCODE_SCHEMA.description: Find code nothing uses: unused imports, unused functions, orphaned error handlers. Returns each category with file, line and symbol plus the total count. Use it for cleanup passes and before declaring a module stable. Next: code_safe_delete for confirmed dead symbols.

path.description: Absolute path to file or directory to scan.

kinds.description: Dead code types: imports, functions, errors, all.

response_format.description: concise returns core fields only (~1/3 of the tokens); detailed returns everything.

ANALYSIS_DEPENDENCY_RISK_SCHEMA.name: analysis_dependency_risk
ANALYSIS_DEPENDENCY_RISK_SCHEMA.description: Rate dependency risk for a file or project: outdated, unmaintained or heavily coupled dependencies. Returns a score per dependency with the reason. Use it when planning upgrades. Next: analysis_security for the code-level view.

ANALYSIS_DIFF_ANALYSIS_SCHEMA.name: analysis_diff_analysis
ANALYSIS_DIFF_ANALYSIS_SCHEMA.description: Compare two git refs and show which symbols changed, with complexity delta and blast radius. Returns changed functions per file plus an impact summary. Use it to review a branch before merging. Next: analysis_review for the security angle.

response_format.description: concise returns core fields only (~1/3 of the tokens); detailed returns everything.

ANALYSIS_DIFF_SCHEMA.name: analysis_diff
ANALYSIS_DIFF_SCHEMA.description: Compare two analysis reports and show what changed between them. Returns added, removed and worsened findings. Use it after a refactor to prove it did not regress. Next: analysis_report to write it up.

ANALYSIS_FRAMEWORK_SCHEMA.name: analysis_framework
ANALYSIS_FRAMEWORK_SCHEMA.description: Identify the frameworks and tooling of a project with confidence scores. Returns each detected framework with version hints and evidence. Use it before choosing language-specific patterns. Next: bug_hunt_scan with the matching preset.

ANALYSIS_GRAPH_SCHEMA.name: analysis_graph
ANALYSIS_GRAPH_SCHEMA.description: Render analysis results as a Mermaid diagram: dependency graph, cycles or summary view. Returns Mermaid source ready to paste. Use it when a picture explains faster than a list. Next: analysis_report to embed it.

ANALYSIS_INSPECT_SCHEMA.name: analysis_inspect
ANALYSIS_INSPECT_SCHEMA.description: One-shot deep dive into a file or directory: symbols, definitions, references, call hierarchy and diagnostics, weighted by depth 1-5. Returns per-layer results plus a summary. Use it as the default entry point when you need to understand unfamiliar code. Next: analysis_architecture for a bird's-eye view.

depth.description:
Analysis depth:
  1: symbols + overview + diagnostics
  2: + capsule + callers + callees
  3: + call_hierarchy + type_hierarchy + highlight
  4: + cycle_detector + dependency_graph + hot_paths
  5: + blast_radius + unused_finder + complexity

response_format.description: concise returns core fields only (~1/3 of the tokens); detailed returns everything.

ANALYSIS_PATTERN_DISCOVER_SCHEMA.name: analysis_pattern_discover
ANALYSIS_PATTERN_DISCOVER_SCHEMA.description: Find bug-shaped code that the shared pattern catalogue does not cover yet. Returns candidate patterns with evidence and a suggested scan query. Use it to grow the catalogue after a hunt found something new. Next: bug_hunt_pattern action=save to make it permanent.

path.description: Absolute path to the project or directory to scan.

ANALYSIS_PERFORMANCE_SCHEMA.name: analysis_performance
ANALYSIS_PERFORMANCE_SCHEMA.description: Look for performance problems: complexity hotspots, diagnostics, hot paths, inlay hints. Returns ranked hotspots with complexity score and the files that dominate. Use it when something is slow or before adding load. Next: analysis_inspect with depth>=4 on the top hotspot.

response_format.description: concise returns core fields only (~1/3 of the tokens); detailed returns everything.

ANALYSIS_REPORT_SCHEMA.name: analysis_report
ANALYSIS_REPORT_SCHEMA.description: Assemble a structured analysis report from findings and recommendations, optionally persisting it. Returns the report document with finding and recommendation counts. Use it as the deliverable at the end of an analysis. Next: hand it to the user or export it.

ANALYSIS_REVIEW_SCHEMA.name: analysis_review
ANALYSIS_REVIEW_SCHEMA.description: Pre-commit style review: diff analysis plus review assistant plus a security pass. Returns changed functions, complexity deltas, security findings and suggested reviewers. Use it before opening a PR or before committing risky changes. Next: fix the findings, then re-run.

response_format.description: concise returns core fields only (~1/3 of the tokens); detailed returns everything.

ANALYSIS_RISK_SCHEMA.name: analysis_risk
ANALYSIS_RISK_SCHEMA.description: Rate the risk of a change or a file: dependency risk, test coverage, blast radius. Returns a 0-10 score with the factors behind it. Use it to decide whether a change needs more testing. Next: code_tests_for_symbol to see what covers it.

categories.description: Risk categories to include (default: all). Options: dependencies, complexity, deadcode, security, hotspots, duplicates

ANALYSIS_SECURITY_SCHEMA.name: analysis_security
ANALYSIS_SECURITY_SCHEMA.description: Security pass: runs the security pattern catalogue and error-handling checks over a path. Returns findings with severity, file, line and the pattern that matched. Use it before a release or when reviewing untrusted-input handling. Next: analysis_review for diff context.

path.description: Absolute path to file or directory to scan.

kinds.description: What kinds of issues to scan for (default: ['all']).

response_format.description: concise returns core fields only (~1/3 of the tokens); detailed returns everything.

ANALYSIS_TEST_INSIGHT_SCHEMA.name: analysis_test_insight
ANALYSIS_TEST_INSIGHT_SCHEMA.description: Work out which tests cover a symbol, and optionally draft new ones. Returns covering test files ranked by relevance, plus generated test skeletons on request. Use it before changing untested code. Next: write the tests, then analysis_review.

path.description: Absolute path to file or directory.

generate.description: Generate test scaffolds for untested symbols (default: false).

ANALYSIS_TREND_SCHEMA.name: analysis_trend
ANALYSIS_TREND_SCHEMA.description: Track how metrics developed across successive runs: finding counts, complexity, coverage. Returns a time series and the direction of change. Use it to show whether quality is improving over time. Next: analysis_report.

scope.description: Scope to analyze (e.g. 'path=src/', 'module:user-service'). Empty = all scopes.

intent.description: Filter by analysis intent. Empty = all intents.

ANALYSIS_UI_GAP_SCHEMA.name: analysis_ui_gap
ANALYSIS_UI_GAP_SCHEMA.description: Compare backend capabilities with frontend usage to find endpoints the UI never calls. Returns the gap list with file references. Use it when a feature exists in the API but not in the product. Next: analysis_ui_inspect for the DOM side.

include_storefront.description: Include storefront routes in analysis (default: true).

include_admin.description: Include admin routes in analysis (default: true).

response_format.description: concise returns core fields only (~1/3 of the tokens); detailed returns everything.

ANALYSIS_WATCH_SCHEMA.name: analysis_watch
ANALYSIS_WATCH_SCHEMA.description: Watch a path and report changes since the last run, so repeated checks stay cheap. Returns newly added and resolved findings. Use it in a loop or a nightly job. Next: analysis_report for the delta summary.

frequency.description: Frequency: daily, hourly, or cron expr.

name.description: Watch name (required for remove). Auto-generated for create.

ANALYSIS_UI_INSPECT_SCHEMA.name: analysis_ui_inspect
ANALYSIS_UI_INSPECT_SCHEMA.description: Inspect rendered UI: DOM structure, selectors and accessibility issues for a route. Returns elements, selectors and findings. Use it when a frontend bug depends on the actual DOM rather than the source. Next: analysis_ui_gap for coverage.

store_baseline.description: Aktuellen Screenshot als Baseline speichern (fuer spaeteren Vergleich).
